caption:
Asian Inspired Fried Eggs
high protein | 15 minute meal | fried eggs | not so lazy breakfast 

Nutrition: 
C: 11 | F: 14 | P: 15
Calories: 249 per serve ( without rice ) 
Serves 1 hungry adults, can be split into 2 portions as well

Ingredients
2 egg
1/2 tsp chilli oil
1-2 spring onion, sliced, use whites in the first part and greens to garnish - i used 1/2 regular onion too because i wanted to :D 
1 chilli, thinly sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp chilli vinegar, i used chings, normal works great too
1 tbsp soy sauce, i prefer light but dark works well too and lends a stronger flavour so choose which you prefer 
1 tbsp chilli sauce ( i use siracha )
1 tbsp oyster sauce 
2 tbsp water
1 sachet monkfruit OR honey 
sesame seeds, for ganish

Method
Whisk together the sauces
Add chilli oil to your frying pan and cook off the onion, garlic and chilli. Crack in the egg and cook the egg on high while you crisp the edges. 
pour in your soy + vinegar + monkfruit sauce and cook for a min until the whites are set and the yolk is still gooey. 

serve with steamed rice and a sprinkle of white sesame seeds

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3
